allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse src, 프로토타입, public | Select-Object FullName | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\', ''\) })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Directory apps, packages -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\', ''\) })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File apps, packages -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\', ''\) })
